interpretations: For each RFI status, including missing status as a separate group, average nonmissing modulation indexes. Keep groups whose average exceeds the overall average across signals. Show each group’s status, average, amount above the overall average, and **absolute difference** from the unweighted mean of the kept groups’ averages; leave all values unrounded

For each RFI status, including missing status as a separate group, average nonmissing modulation indexes. Keep groups whose average exceeds the overall average across signals. Show each group’s status, average, amount above the overall average, and **signed difference** from the unweighted mean of the kept groups’ averages (group average minus that mean); leave all values unrounded
For each kept RFI status, report the signed difference as the mean of the kept statuses’ averages minus that status’s average modulation index; leave all values unrounded
queries:
WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
    FROM signals
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS group_avg
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
kept AS (
    SELECT grouped.rfistat, grouped.group_avg, overall.overall_avg
    FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall
    WHERE grouped.group_avg > overall.overall_avg
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    group_avg,
    group_avg - overall_avg AS amount_above_overall,
    ABS(group_avg - (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM kept)) AS absolute_difference
FROM kept

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS group_average
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
kept_groups AS (
    SELECT
        g.rfistat,
        g.group_average,
        g.group_average - o.overall_average AS amount_above_overall
    FROM group_averages AS g
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_average
        FROM signals
    ) AS o
    WHERE g.group_average > o.overall_average
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    group_average,
    amount_above_overall,
    group_average - AVG(group_average) OVER () AS signed_difference
FROM kept_groups

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE rfistat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
  HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT rfistat,
       (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM status_averages) - avg_modindex AS signed_difference
FROM status_averages
